verdict.rationale: The README says the skill uses the open Agent Skills format, a folder with a SKILL.md, and works in any agent that supports skills. It also offers vendor-neutral folder-copy installation alongside the Claude plugin route. This directly addresses portability beyond one vendor's tooling, but the evidence is first-party only and thin on spec details. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the folder runs in non-Claude agents, documentation of SKILL.md frontmatter and spec-conformance details.

support.subject: As a developer, skills follow the open Agent Skills specification so the same skill folder is valid beyond this one vendor's tooling
